companies.name: Against the Grain Theatre
companies.description: Against the Grain Theatre is a Canadian opera company dedicated to presenting genre-bending, boundary-breaking operatic and vocal works, making opera accessible in relaxed, friendly venues.

productions.title: Opera Pub (October Edition)
productions.address: 292 Brunswick Ave, Toronto, ON M5S 2M6
productions.price: Free Admission (Pay what you can / Registration encouraged)
productions.description: Against the Grain Theatre's signature Opera Pub returns to the TRANZAC! Experience live opera with a beer in hand, featuring talented singers in a relaxed, friendly environment. Perfect introduction for newcomers and a welcome break for opera veterans.

productions.title: Opera Pub (November Edition)
productions.address: 292 Brunswick Ave, Toronto, ON M5S 2M6
productions.price: Free Admission (Pay what you can / Registration encouraged)
productions.description: Against the Grain Theatre's signature Opera Pub returns to the TRANZAC! Experience live opera with a beer in hand, featuring talented singers in a relaxed, friendly environment. Perfect introduction for newcomers and a welcome break for opera veterans.

productions.title: Dog Days
productions.address: 877 Yonge St, Suite 201, Toronto, ON M4W 3M2
productions.description: The Canadian premiere of David T. Little and Royce Vavrek's dystopian rock opera, Dog Days. Co-produced with Tapestry Opera and directed by Michael Hidetoshi Mori. This dark, visceral work combines classical vocals with electric guitars to explore survival, family, and humanity in a post-apocalyptic world.

productions.title: Opera Pub (Holiday Edition)
productions.address: 292 Brunswick Ave, Toronto, ON M5S 2M6
productions.price: Free Admission (Pay what you can / Registration encouraged)
productions.description: A special festive holiday edition of AtG's signature Opera Pub at the TRANZAC! Enjoy your favorite operatic tunes with seasonal cheer, cold beer, and community warmth.

companies.name: Alliance for Canadian Musicals
companies.description: The Alliance for Canadian Musicals is an organization dedicated to the development, production, and promotion of Canadian musical theatre, showcasing original works and Canadian talent.

productions.title: The Wounds of Love and Other Gifts
productions.address: 16 Ryerson Ave, Toronto, ON M5T 2R2
productions.description: An intimate music-theatre meditation on love, sacrifice, and the cost of giving, inspired by the words of Oscar Wilde. Written, composed, and directed by Bruce Dow.

companies.name: Amplified Opera
companies.description: Amplified Opera is a Toronto-based collective that places artists at the center of public discourse. They foster equity, inclusivity, and representation in classical music, creating a space for marginalized and equity-seeking creators to push the boundaries of the art form.

companies.name: Apocryphonia
companies.description: Apocryphonia Concert Series explores forgotten, neglected, and contemporary musical works, presenting unique, immersive chamber music experiences in Toronto.

productions.title: Of Whales and Willpower: The Jamaican Jonah, Pt. 1
productions.address: 1570 Yonge Street, Toronto, ON M4T 1Z8
productions.description: A journey through classical organ works by composers of Jamaican and West Indian heritage, spanning from the Baroque era to the present day. Emerging Jamaican-Canadian organist Joshua Duncan-Lee premieres works by Jamaica's first classical composer, Samuel Felsted, including excerpts of the 1775 oratorio 'Jonah'—the first oratorio written in the Western Hemisphere.

companies.name: Benevolence Opera Project
companies.description: Founded by Artistic Director Ryan Hofman, the Benevolence Opera Project is dedicated to producing high-quality opera performances that combine artistic excellence with community engagement and support for meaningful causes.

productions.title: Don Giovanni
productions.address: 1300 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Y7
productions.description: Mozart's masterpiece presented as a one-night-only community fundraiser. Partnering with the Redwood Theatre to raise funds and awareness for the Redwood Women's Shelter.

companies.name: Canadian Children's Opera Company
companies.description: The CCOC provides unique operatic training and performance opportunities for children and youth, producing professional-level staged operas and collaborating regularly with the Canadian Opera Company.

productions.title: Phantom of the Music Room
productions.address: 227 Front St. E. Toronto, ON M5A 1E8
productions.description: Presented by the CCOC Junior Division, this is a 30-minute musical mystery filled with clever songs set to classical melodies by Chopin, Dvořák, Sousa, and more. Join the young choristers as they solve the mysteries hidden in their school music room in this imaginative, family-friendly staging.

companies.name: Canadian Opera Company
companies.description: Based in Toronto, the Canadian Opera Company is the largest opera company in Canada and one of the largest producers of opera in North America, performing in the state-of-the-art Four Seasons Centre.

productions.title: La Traviata
productions.venue: Four Seasons Centre for the Performing Arts
productions.address: 145 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5H 4G1
productions.description: One of opera's most beloved tragedies. Verdi's exquisite portrait of a glamorous courtesan sacrifice in Paris. Led by an international cast and spectacular staging at the Four Seasons Centre.

productions.title: Così fan tutte
productions.venue: Four Seasons Centre for the Performing Arts
productions.address: 145 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5H 4G1
productions.description: Mozart's sparkling, witty comedy exploring fidelity, deception, and human relationships in a stunning classical production filled with unforgettable ensembles.

productions.title: The Turn of the Screw
productions.venue: Four Seasons Centre for the Performing Arts
productions.address: 145 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5H 4G1
productions.description: Britten's spine-chilling chamber masterpiece based on Henry James's classic ghost story. A tense psychological thriller exploring isolation and the corruption of innocence.

productions.title: Ariadne auf Naxos
productions.venue: Four Seasons Centre for the Performing Arts
productions.address: 145 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5H 4G1
productions.description: A delightful mash-up of high art opera and low-brow commedia dell'arte comedy, featuring one of the most vocally demanding soprano roles in the entire repertoire.

productions.title: Empire of Wild
productions.venue: Four Seasons Centre for the Performing Arts
productions.address: 145 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5H 4G1
productions.description: World Premiere. A powerful new Canadian opera based on Cherie Dimaline's bestselling novel, weaving Métis folklore of the Rogarou with a story of love, loss, and community resilience.

productions.title: The Elixir of Love
productions.venue: Four Seasons Centre for the Performing Arts
productions.address: 145 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5H 4G1
productions.description: Donizetti's charming and funny romantic comedy, boasting some of the composer's most famous tunes including 'Una furtiva lagrima'. Perfect for opera beginners.

productions.title: Come Closer
productions.address: 227 Front St E, Toronto, ON M5A 1E8
productions.description: An intimate, contemporary production staged at the COC Theatre, exploring memory, connection, and the spaces between us in a modern operatic language.

companies.name: Confluence Concerts
companies.description: Confluence Concerts is a Toronto-based chamber and vocal music collective founded by Larry Beckwith, presenting eclectic, intimate, and thought-provoking musical experiences curated by a team of diverse artists.

productions.title: Canadian Art Song Project
productions.address: 35 Hazelton Ave, Toronto, ON M5R 2E3
productions.description: Co-presented with the Canadian Art Song Project (CASP). A beautiful recital program featuring works by female Canadian composers, performed by soprano Jonelle Sills and baritone Jesse Blumberg, accompanied by pianists Helen Becqué and Steven Philcox.

productions.title: Metal Mozart
productions.time: April 17 at 8:00 PM, April 18 at 2:00 PM
productions.address: 35 Hazelton Ave, Toronto, ON M5R 2E3
productions.description: Curated by Teiya Kasahara. Audiences can rock out to your favourite classical bangers! Metal Mozart features hardcore instrumentals and operatic grit to explore the concept of a rock opera, blending Mozart's classical masterpieces with heavy metal.

companies.name: Fawn Chamber Creative
companies.description: Exploring new directions in music, theater, and opera, FAWN Chamber Creative is a Toronto-based collective that produces multidisciplinary works, workshops, and immersive performance experiences.

companies.name: No Strings Theatre
companies.description: No Strings Theatre is a Toronto-based charitable organization dedicated to providing emerging and young artists with training, mentorship, and showcase opportunities in theatre and opera, breaking down barriers and fostering inclusivity in the performing arts.

productions.title: Hands Together for Opera
productions.address: 109 Vanderhoof Ave Suite 15, East York, ON M4G 2H7
productions.description: Part of the Summer Soundscape Concert Series. Featuring acclaimed pianists Greg Millar and Lisa Raposa Millar, this performance presents beloved opera favorites reimagined for one piano, four hands.

productions.title: Opera BrewHaHa
productions.address: 245 Eglinton Ave E, Toronto, ON M4P 3B7
productions.description: A relaxed, pub-style fundraiser featuring arias, music theatre, and contemporary songs, along with a silent auction. Held at the Granite Brewery and Tied House, this event is part of No Strings Theatre's Summerstage 2026 season.

productions.title: The Marriage of Figaro
productions.time: Friday @ 7:30 PM, Saturday @ 2:00 PM & 7:30 PM, Sunday @ 2:00 PM
productions.venue: Church of St. Peter and St. Simon (SPSS)
productions.address: 525 Bloor St E, Toronto, ON M4W 1J1
productions.description: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's brilliant comic masterpiece The Marriage of Figaro, presented as the culminating performance of No Strings Theatre's Summer 2026 Emerging Artist Opera Intensive. Directed by Rob Herriot and under the music direction of Vlad Soloviev, this fully staged production features a talented cast of emerging opera singers performing Mozart's witty and sparkling farce.

companies.name: Opera 5
companies.description: Opera 5 is a Toronto-based opera company dedicated to producing funny, fast-paced, and engaging operatic experiences, bridging the gap between traditional theater and modern audiences.

productions.title: Suor Angelica & Gianni Schicchi
productions.address: Toronto, ON (Venues TBA)
productions.description: An intimate, fresh double bill of Puccini's masterworks Suor Angelica and Gianni Schicchi, featuring a new chamber reduction by Music Director Evan Mitchell. Directed by Jessica Derventzis, this production weaves rising talents with Canadian opera stars like Krisztina Szabó and Rachel Krehm.

productions.title: Parḗlios
productions.address: Toronto, ON (Venues TBA)
productions.description: World Premiere of a bold new Canadian opera. Cecilia Livingston's haunting score merges opera, installation, and oratorio, featuring the TorQ Percussion Ensemble. Exploring themes of survival, light, and mathematical symmetry.

companies.name: Opera Atelier
companies.description: Opera Atelier is Canada's premier baroque opera company, specializing in historically informed, spectacular productions featuring period dancing, acting, and music in Toronto.

productions.title: The Descent of Orpheus
productions.address: 273 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1W2
productions.description: Fully staged Canadian Premiere of Charpentier's baroque masterwork 'La descente d'Orphée aux enfers'. Converted into a rich period experience featuring American tenor Daniel McGrew in his Opera Atelier debut as Orpheus and soprano Mireille Asselin as Eurydice. Conducted by Christopher Bagan and choreographed by Jeannette Lajeunesse Zingg.

productions.title: The Resurrection
productions.address: 273 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1W2
productions.description: A welcome remount of Opera Atelier's critically acclaimed, multi-layered production of Handel's early Italian masterpiece 'La Resurrezione'. Led by music director David Fallis, featuring stunning scenery, dramatic period dance choreography, and an all-star Canadian cast.

companies.name: Opera by Request
companies.description: Founded in 2007 by pianist and music director William Shookhoff, Opera by Request is a unique, artist-driven chamber opera company in Toronto. Repertoire is chosen and co-produced by the participating singers, providing emerging and established artists with the opportunity to study and perform complete operatic roles in concert format with piano accompaniment.

productions.title: Tristan und Isolde
productions.address: 16 Baby Point Rd, York, ON M6S 2G3
productions.description: Richard Wagner's monumental opera of love, passion, and death, performed in concert format with piano accompaniment. Directed and conducted from the piano by William Shookhoff.

productions.title: Laura—A Canadian Tragedy
productions.composer: Chiara Urban / Libretto by Jessica Spurrell
productions.address: Toronto, ON
productions.description: World Premiere. Commissioned to commemorate Opera by Request's 20th anniversary, 'Laura—A Canadian Tragedy' tells the story of Canadian heroine Laura Secord. With music by Chiara Urban and libretto by Jessica Spurrell, the opera explores her struggles as an impoverished and unappreciated figure in post-1812 Canada.

companies.name: Opera by the Glass
companies.description: Opera by the Glass is an active chamber opera company in the Greater Toronto Area, bringing classical vocal music to intimate, unconventional spaces.

companies.name: Opéra Queens
companies.description: Opéra Queens is a classical vocal collective based in Toronto and Montréal presenting classical music, art song, and opera through a queer, drag, and gender-bent lens, prioritizing QTBIPOC artists and 'dragging opera into the 21st century'.

productions.title: Proud Voices 2.0
productions.address: 292 Brunswick Ave, Toronto, ON M5S 2M6
productions.description: A Pride Month open mic celebrating queer and diverse voices. Hosted by drag diva Tania Smania (Mike Fan), featuring classical vocal highlights, gender-bent opera, and a community open mic segment in the Tranzac's Southern Cross Lounge.

productions.title: Summer Song Café
productions.address: 292 Brunswick Ave, Toronto, ON M5S 2M6
productions.description: Part of Opéra Queens' historic six-month residency at the Tranzac Club. A casual and lively summer evening showcase of classical song, opera favorites, and community open mic performances in a welcoming queer-friendly space.

productions.title: Opera Sustenida
productions.address: 292 Brunswick Ave, Toronto, ON M5S 2M6
productions.description: Opéra Queens' monthly residency performance at the Tranzac Club. Drag-infused and gender-bent operatic performance and community open mic, bringing classical vocal music to a relaxed, inclusive neighborhood venue.

productions.title: Latin Night
productions.address: 292 Brunswick Ave, Toronto, ON M5S 2M6
productions.description: Concluding the six-month Tranzac residency with a Latin Night theme, featuring classical vocal works by Spanish and Latin American composers, drag-opera segments, and community open mic slots.

companies.name: Opera Revue
companies.description: Opera Revue makes opera accessible, fun, and casual by performing high-quality opera in neighborhood bars, breweries, and lounges. They are known for their regular series at the Granite Brewery, themed events like Drag Me to the Opera, and cross-over mashups like OperaMANIA.

productions.title: Drag Me to the Opera
productions.address: 245 Eglinton Ave E, Toronto, ON M4P 3B7
productions.description: Opera Revue presents their hit show 'Drag Me to the Opera' at the Granite Brewery! Experience an incredible, high-energy collaboration blending classical opera arias with fabulous drag performances, hosted by Gregory Finney and starring drag sensation Selena Vyle.

companies.name: Opera York
companies.description: Serving York Region and northern Toronto, Opera York provides professional staged performance opportunities for emerging Canadian classical artists, presenting accessible and beautiful standard repertoire.

productions.title: Pirates of Penzance
productions.venue: Richmond Hill Centre for the Performing Arts
productions.address: 10268 Yonge St, Richmond Hill, ON L4C 3B7
productions.description: Gilbert & Sullivan's classic comic opera about Frederic, a pirate apprentice released on his 21st birthday who discovers he was born on a leap year (February 29) and is bound to serve them until his actual 21st birthday. A full production featuring chorus, orchestra, and surtitles, directed by Penelope Cookson with music direction by Geoffrey Butler.

companies.name: Southern Ontario Lyric Opera
companies.description: Southern Ontario Lyric Opera (SOLO) is a professional opera company based in Burlington and Hamilton, dedicated to presenting classic operatic works, highlighting local talents and educational programs.

productions.title: An outdoor Concert under the Stars
productions.address: 420 Crerar Dr, Hamilton, ON L9A 5K3, Canada
productions.description: Celebrate Italian Heritage Month with Southern Ontario Lyric Opera! An outdoor summer evening concert under the stars featuring beloved operatic selections, aria favorites, and classic ensembles. (Rain date scheduled for Friday, June 19th).

companies.name: Summer Opera Lyric Theatre
companies.description: For over 40 years, Summer Opera Lyric Theatre has provided intensive professional training for emerging singer-actors, presenting staged productions in an intimate summer festival setting.

productions.title: The Medium
productions.address: 70 Berkeley Street, Toronto, ON M5A 2W6
productions.description: A gripping two-act dramatic chamber opera exploring the supernatural, fraud, and psychological breakdown. Conducted by Vlad Soloviev and featuring SOLT's new generation of operatic talents.

productions.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
productions.composer: Victor Davies / Eugene Benson (after Oscar Wilde)
productions.address: 70 Berkeley Street, Toronto, ON M5A 2W6
productions.description: Oscar Wilde's legendary comedy of manners is brilliantly adapted into a witty, melodic opera by Victor Davies and Eugene Benson. A delightful musical romp through high-society double lives.

productions.title: Katya Kabanova
productions.address: 70 Berkeley Street, Toronto, ON M5A 2W6
productions.description: Janáček's heartbreaking masterwork of oppression, forbidden passion, and tragic fate on the Volga River. Presented in an intimate, powerful staging under music director Minira Najafzade.

companies.name: Tapestry Opera
companies.description: Tapestry Opera is an award-winning Canadian opera company based in Toronto, dedicated to creating, developing, and producing modern, boundary-pushing contemporary operas.

productions.title: Dog Days
productions.address: 877 Yonge St, Suite 201, Toronto, ON M4W 3M2
productions.description: Canadian premiere of David T. Little & Royce Vavrek's dystopian rock opera. Co-produced with Against the Grain Theatre. Combining classical vocals with electric guitars, this dark psychological drama explores human resilience and survival in a time of global collapse.

productions.title: Forbidden
productions.address: 877 Yonge St, Suite 201, Toronto, ON M4W 3M2
productions.description: World Premiere. Blending traditional opera, rap, and Persian classical orchestration, this genre-defying hip-hop fusion opera by Afarin Mansouri and Donna-Michelle St. Bernard explores themes of freedom, rules, and power.

productions.title: Songbook XIII
productions.address: 877 Yonge St, Suite 201, Toronto, ON M4W 3M2
productions.description: Showcasing Canada's next generation of emerging artists performing highlights from Tapestry's extensive collection of contemporary Canadian repertoire.

companies.name: The Glenn Gould School
companies.description: The vocal program of the Royal Conservatory's Glenn Gould School is an elite training ground for emerging opera artists, presenting fully staged operas accompanied by the Royal Conservatory Orchestra.

productions.title: The Glenn Gould School Chamber Opera
productions.address: 273 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1W2
productions.description: Students from The Glenn Gould School’s vocal program present a double bill of Samuel Barber’s A Hand of Bridge, a poignant miniature opera that reveals the hidden thoughts of four bridge players during a seemingly ordinary card game, and Leonard Bernstein’s Trouble in Tahiti, a jazz-infused one-act opera depicting a day in the life of a troubled married couple living in 1950s suburbia. Conducted by Jennifer Tung and directed by Mario Pacheco.

productions.title: The Glenn Gould School Spring Opera: Le nozze di Figaro
productions.address: 273 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1W2
productions.description: Students from The Glenn Gould School’s vocal program present Mozart’s brilliant comedy Le nozze di Figaro (The Marriage of Figaro), fully staged in Koerner Hall. Conducted by Judith Yan and featuring the future stars of classical voice, supported by the Royal Conservatory Orchestra.

companies.name: The Redwood Theatre
companies.description: The Redwood Theatre is a historic performing arts venue and community hub in Toronto's east end. Originally opened as a cinema in 1914, it hosts a diverse array of performing arts, circus training, music, and community events, including its accessible 'Opera for Everyone' lounge concert series.

productions.title: Opera 303
productions.venue: The Redwood Theatre & Centre for the Per
productions.address: 1300 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Y7
productions.description: This is the 3rd in our opera for everyone series. Hosted by Alex Hajek, this intimate lounge concert is a joyous venture into the world of opera, making it fun and accessible. Join us. Doors open at 2:30 pm, show starts at 3 pm.

productions.title: Canuck Cantatas - Friday 8pm
productions.address: 1300 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Y7
productions.description:
Three world premieres…six visionary artists…one inventive night of Canadian opera!
Doors open at 7pm. Show starts at 8pm

productions.title: La Bohème
productions.address: 1300 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Y7
productions.description:
La Bohème

Opera comes to the Redwood. 
come hear some of Canada’s finest singers present La Bohème. There will also be a
silent auction on site to benefit Daily Bread Food Bread. 
Doors open at 7pm. Show begins at 8pm.
Mingling and cocktail reception starts at 7pm.

productions.title: Opera 202
productions.address: 1300 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Y7
productions.description:
Back by popular demand, 
Opera 202 is set to return to the Redwood Theatre for its 2nd series of educational and performative concerts. 
Doors open at 1:30pm. Takes place on the 3rd floor in the Redwood Studio. Limited space, intimate setting. Join us. Access to studios is via stairs only.

productions.title: Opera Revue presents: Cabaret to Modern Day
productions.address: 1300 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Y7
productions.description:
Cabaret to Modern Day
Doors open at 7pm
Show starts at 8pm

productions.title: Opera Revue presents: Bach-Humbug
productions.address: 1300 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Y7
productions.description:
Xmas, while a joyful season for some, is not for others. This show is for them. This show is for us.
Bach-Humbug will have no gimmicks (we blew our budget on the circus people).
Doors at 7, show at 8

productions.title: Opera Revue Presents: Ruckus! at The Redwood! Opera Revue's Annual Gala Vol. 3.0  The Circus Edition
productions.address: 1300 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Y7
productions.description:
Opera Revue Presents: Ruckus! at The Redwood! Opera Revue's Annual Gala Vol. 3.0 The Circus Edition. Sunday November 10, 2024. 
Please note:
Doors open at 7pm, Show begins at 8pm.

productions.title: Opera Revue presents: Trills, Chills and Frills in collaboration with Opera Atelier
productions.address: 1300 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1Y7
productions.description: We are absolutely thrilled to announce our partnership with Opera Atelier for our TRILLS, CHILLS AND FRILLS a spooky Halloween masquerade show.

companies.name: Toronto City Opera
companies.description: Toronto City Opera (TCO) is a community-focused opera company in downtown Toronto, providing staged performances of standard and modern operatic works while engaging amateur and emerging singers.

productions.title: Orpheus in the Underworld
productions.address: 427 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1X7
productions.description: Offenbach's sparkling, satirical operetta turns classic Greek myths on their head in a witty comedy. Featuring the famous 'Can-Can' melody, fully staged in English with the North York Concert Orchestra in the pit.

productions.title: La Bohème
productions.address: 207 Queens Quay West, Toronto, ON M5J 1A7
productions.description: A luminous portrait of young artists chasing love and life in bohemian Paris. When the seamstress Mimì meets the poet Rodolfo, their romance blossoms amid friendship, laughter, and the harsh realities of poverty. With some of the most unforgettable melodies in opera, Giacomo Puccini’s romantic masterpiece captures the beauty and fragility of love.

productions.title: The Pirates of Penzance
productions.address: 207 Queens Quay West, Toronto, ON M5J 1A7
productions.description: Gilbert and Sullivan's classic comic operetta about Frederic, an apprentice pirate who, having reached his 21st year, is released from his apprenticeship but discovers that he was born on a leap year, meaning he must remain bound to the pirates until he is 63. Featuring beloved characters like the Major-General and the Pirate King, and classic songs like 'I am the very model of a modern Major-General'. Sung in English with projected sung text.

companies.name: Toronto Summer Music
companies.description: Toronto Summer Music is an annual summer festival and academy presenting world-class chamber music and art song performances in Toronto's prestigious Koerner Hall.

productions.title: La descente d'Orphée aux enfers & Les arts florissants
productions.address: 273 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1W2
productions.description: Toronto Summer Music Opening Night. Under the direction of William Christie, the legendary early music ensemble Les Arts Florissants performs a staged double-bill of Charpentier's baroque masterpieces: 'La descente d'Orphée aux enfers' and the chamber opera 'Les arts florissants'. Followed by a celebratory champagne reception.

productions.title: Sasha Cooke & Warren Jones: Of Thee I Sing
productions.composer: Various / Recital (Copland, Barber, Weill, Sondheim, Gershwin, Granados)
productions.address: 80 Queen's Park, Toronto, ON M5S 2C5
productions.description: Celebrated mezzo-soprano Sasha Cooke (Art of Song Mentor) and pianist Warren Jones perform 'Of Thee I Sing,' a recital program exploring themes of hope and connection through works by American composers (Copland, Barber, Weill, Sondheim, Gershwin) and selections from Granados's Tonadillas.

productions.title: Golden Age: Erin Morley & Lawrence Brownlee
productions.address: 273 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1W2
productions.description: Met Opera stars Erin Morley (soprano) and Lawrence Brownlee (tenor), accompanied by pianist Malcolm Martineau, perform their celebrated 'Golden Age' program, featuring a selection of 19th-century French and Italian opera arias and duets.

companies.name: Ubu Opera
companies.description: Ubu Opera is a Toronto-based collective dedicated to creating music theatre that fuses classical chamber music with physical theatre.

productions.title: Songs for Moby Dick
productions.address: 16 Ryerson Ave, Toronto, ON M5T 2R2
productions.description: A fully staged, movement-based operatic adaptation of Herman Melville's novel, exploring themes of obsession, violence, beauty, and nature. Directed by Adam Paolozza, featuring Peter Thompson as Ishmael and Dr. Erika Reiman at the piano.

companies.name: University of Toronto Opera
companies.description: The University of Toronto Faculty of Music's Opera division is one of Canada's premier training grounds for opera, offering comprehensive graduate performance training and presenting fully staged productions accompanied by the U of T Symphony Orchestra.

productions.title: Fall River, the legend of Lizzie Borden
productions.address: Edward Johnson Building, 80 Queen's Park, Toronto, ON M5S 2C5
productions.description: The world premiere of Fall River, the legend of Lizzie Borden, with music by Cecilia Livingston and libretto/direction by Michael Patrick Albano. This major new commission marks the U of T Opera division's first commissioned work in twenty-five years, celebrating the reopening of the MacMillan Theatre.

companies.name: Voicebox: Opera in Concert
companies.description: Founded in 1974 by Stuart Hamilton, VOICEBOX: Opera in Concert is Canada's oldest voice-only opera company. It is dedicated to presenting rarely performed operatic masterpieces in a concert format, focusing on musical expression and emerging Canadian vocal talent.

productions.title: Phantoms and Apparitions
productions.address: 947 Queen Street East, 2nd Floor, Toronto, ON M4M 1J9
productions.description: An intimate Opera Salon performance exploring themes of ghosts, spirits, and the supernatural in opera and classical song. Featuring emerging Canadian vocalists.

productions.title: Die tote Stadt
productions.venue: Jeanne Lamon Hall, Trinity-St. Paul’s Centre
productions.address: 427 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1X7
productions.description: Erich Wolfgang Korngold's intense, symbolist masterpiece about grief, obsession, and memory, set in the atmospheric streets of Bruges. Featuring Lauren Margison (Marie/Marietta) and Scott Rumble (Paul/Jason).

productions.title: The Canadian Opus and Anne Hebert's Novel
productions.address: 947 Queen Street East, 2nd Floor, Toronto, ON M4M 1J9
productions.description: An educational and musical exploration of Charles Wilson's Kamouraska and its literary origins in Anne Hébert's classic novel.

productions.title: Manon
productions.venue: Jeanne Lamon Hall, Trinity-St. Paul’s Centre
productions.address: 427 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1X7
productions.description: Jules Massenet's tragic masterpiece depicting the rise and fall of the beautiful, headstrong Manon Lescaut and her passionate romance with the Chevalier des Grieux. Featuring Diana Rockwell (Manon Lescaut) and Colin Ainsworth (Le Chevalier des Grieux).

productions.title: Kamouraska
productions.venue: Jeanne Lamon Hall, Trinity-St. Paul’s Centre
productions.address: 427 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1X7
productions.description: A powerful Canadian chamber opera based on Anne Hébert's famous historical novel of love, murder, and guilt in 19th-century Quebec. Featuring Maeve Palmer (Elizabeth D’Aulnières).
